## Project Overview
This is a React application built with TypeScript and Vite. The project follows modern React development patterns and best practices.

## Key Guidelines
- Use TypeScript for all new components and utilities
- Follow React 18+ patterns including hooks and functional components
- Use Vite for build and development tooling
- Maintain clean, readable code with proper type annotations
- Use modern CSS or CSS-in-JS solutions for styling
- Follow component composition patterns
- Use proper error handling and loading states
- Implement accessibility best practices

## Development Notes
- The development server runs on `npm run dev`
- Build the project with `npm run build`
- Preview the production build with `npm run preview`
- Use the built-in TypeScript checking and ESLint configuration
